reproduction.expected: The WP-08 coordinator discovers the exact open ReleaseRun ledger regardless of unrelated repository issue volume, retires an exhausted ledger only after all existing authorization and run checks pass, and prevents a second active ReleaseRun.
reproduction.actual: The coordinator scans only the first 1000 unfiltered open issues; live ledger #696 is outside that range, so its valid retirement comment is silently ignored and global active-run detection returns no ledger.

violated_invariants: One active WP-08 ReleaseRun must remain globally discoverable before authorization, recovery, retirement, or repair continuation changes state.
A valid authorized retirement command must not be silently ignored because unrelated issues consume a generic pagination window.
Ambiguous, incomplete, or excessive ReleaseRun discovery must fail closed instead of being interpreted as no active run.
